Groudon

Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3 · Legendary Pokémon

Groudon is a Ground-type Continent Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 3.5 m tall and weighs 950 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (150), with a base stat total of 670.
